summary: The diff implements Array.prototype.slice steps 1–10 in order, with `?` on every abrupt completion. Start is converted before end, and end is skipped when undefined. The observable sequence in the loop is ToString, HasProperty, Get, then CreateDataPropertyOrThrow, followed by the final Set(array, "length", n, true). The local to_clamped_index helper follows ToAbsoluteIndex (-inf → 0, negative relative to length, else min with length) and then clamps. The ±inf, NaN and -0 cases work out. No test-specific branches, no swallowed errors, and no made-up values. The remaining not-implemented paths (Function, Proxy, TypedArray, preventExtensions) throw the engine's not-implemented error, which is honest partial work. The gate reports 118 new passes and no regressions.
